sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
purpose: One read-only fleet runner supervises many specialist watches without requiring one ChatGPT automation per watch.
notificationLaw: specialists stay quiet unless state materially changes; Titan7 reconciler summarizes cross-cutting changes

watches.description: Canonical repository, authority and current main identity remain coherent.
Detect stale main pointers, authority creep and historical evidence mislabeled as current truth.
Current-candidate PR heads, exact-head CI and mergeability.
Reject write-all and pull_request_target trust-boundary surprises.
Detect mutable actions/*@vN refs.
Detect secret-like literals or private keys in tracked text.
Track historical .lan references until explicitly historical, migrated or retired.
Track buildOnis legacy naming versus forgeOniTwins canonical identity.
Verify CAST boundary files exist and no repo-local contract grants build authority without explicit cast.
Branch protection and rulesets across canonical and support roots.
APK package/version/signature/alignment artifact evidence.
Install, launch, rotation, cutout, touch and real-device proof.
Unlock Shizuku bind only after cockpit physical proof.
Material Android WebView/Chromium/Edge Gallery compatibility changes.
Unexpected public exposure, endpoint drift, certificate/runtime changes.
Required receipts exist and Drive visibility matches intended data class.
Owned/CC0/permissive/private-reference boundaries and provenance markers.
Unpinned or unexpectedly broad dependency ranges in authoritative lanes.
Required snapshot refs and recovery evidence still resolve.
Produce one compact Professor-facing milestone from all watches.
Reconcile Shizuku UID/permission state, Termux:X11 app+companion pairing, proot shared-tmp state, session process evidence and physical render proof without conflating privilege layers.
